close_reason: chain_walk NC init comment now explains RFC §6.1.2 scope covers all certs including intermediates
description: chain_walk seeds nc_permitted and nc_excluded from the trust anchor's name_constraints before iterating the chain root-to-leaf. This means anchor NC constraints are applied to intermediate CA certs in the chain as well as the leaf — which is correct per RFC 5280 §6.1 initial state, but the comment only says 'seed initial state from trust anchor NC (§6.1.2 step e/f)'. A future contributor who sees that intermediates are being checked against anchor NC may assume this is a bug and remove the seeding, breaking the invariant. The comment should explicitly note that RFC 5280 §6.1 requires anchor NC to be enforced on all certs including intermediates.
title: anchor NC seeding applied to intermediate CAs not documented
